mutual
theorem $A.w : $A → True
  | .nil => trivial
  | .mk b => b.w
  termination_by structural x => x
theorem $B.w : {n : Nat} → $B n → True
  | _, .z => trivial
  | _, .s a b => let _ := a.w; b.w
  termination_by structural _ x => x
end

inductive $A : Type where
  | nil
  | mk : {n : Nat} → $B n → $A

inductive $B : Nat → Type where
  | z : $B 0
  | s : {n : Nat} → $A → $B n → $B (n + 1)

inductive $C : Nat → Nat → Type where
  | z : $C 0 0
  | s : {n m : Nat} → $A → $C n m
end
mutual
def $A.w : $A → Nat
  | .nil => 0
  | .mk b => b.w + 1
  termination_by structural x => x
def $B.w : {n : Nat} → $B n → Nat
  | _, .z => 0
  | _, .s a b => a.w + b.w
  termination_by structural _ x => x
end
